about: Statements the DuckDB workspace runs (src/lib/duckdb/sql.ts). duckdb.test.ts checks the builders produce exactly these strings ({dir} = '/tmp/dk'); duckdb_integration.rs runs them in order on the real engine ({dir} = a temp folder). Steps whose key starts with 'setup.' are plain SQL that only prepares data.

steps.sql: COPY (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'An', 10.5, DATE '2026-01-02'), (2, 'B;o', 7.0, DATE '2026-01-03'), (3, 'Chi', NULL, DATE '2026-02-01')) t(id, name, amount, day)) TO '{dir}/Sales 2026.csv' (FORMAT csv, HEADER true, DELIMITER ';')
COPY (SELECT 1 AS id, ['x', 'y'] AS tags UNION ALL SELECT 2, []) TO '{dir}/tags.json' (FORMAT json, ARRAY true)

SELECT version() AS version, (SELECT platform FROM pragma_platform()) AS platform, current_database() AS database, current_schema() AS schema, current_setting('threads') AS threads, current_setting('memory_limit') AS memory_limit, (SELECT count(*) FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE NOT internal) AS tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM duckdb_views() WHERE NOT internal) AS views, (SELECT coalesce(sum(estimated_size), 0) FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE NOT internal) AS est_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM duckdb_extensions() WHERE loaded) AS extensions_loaded

SELECT d.database_name AS name, d.path, d.type, d.readonly, s.database_size, s.wal_size, s.block_size, s.total_blocks, s.used_blocks, s.free_blocks, s.memory_usage, (d.database_name = current_database()) AS current FROM duckdb_databases() d LEFT JOIN pragma_database_size() s ON s.database_name = d.database_name WHERE NOT d.internal ORDER BY current DESC, name

SELECT database_name, schema_name, table_name, estimated_size, column_count, index_count FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE NOT internal ORDER BY estimated_size DESC, database_name, schema_name, table_name LIMIT 10
SELECT tag, memory_usage_bytes, temporary_storage_bytes FROM duckdb_memory() ORDER BY memory_usage_bytes DESC, tag
SELECT path, size FROM duckdb_temporary_files() ORDER BY size DESC

SELECT extension_name, loaded, installed, install_path, description, aliases, extension_version, install_mode, installed_from FROM duckdb_extensions() ORDER BY loaded DESC, installed DESC, extension_name
SELECT name, value, description, input_type, scope FROM duckdb_settings() ORDER BY name
LOAD json
SET GLOBAL threads = '2'
SELECT current_setting('threads') AS v
SET GLOBAL preserve_insertion_order = 'false'
SELECT current_setting('preserve_insertion_order') AS v
RESET GLOBAL threads
RESET GLOBAL preserve_insertion_order
SELECT current_setting('preserve_insertion_order') AS v
DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM read_csv('{dir}/Sales 2026.csv', header = true, delim = ';')
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{dir}/Sales 2026.csv', header = true, delim = ';') LIMIT 100
SELECT count(*) AS "rows" FROM read_csv('{dir}/Sales 2026.csv', header = true, delim = ';')
SELECT * FROM read_json('{dir}/tags.json', format = 'array') LIMIT 100
CREATE TABLE "main"."sales_2026" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv('{dir}/Sales 2026.csv', header = true, delim = ';')
INSERT INTO "main"."sales_2026" BY NAME SELECT CAST("id" AS INTEGER) AS "id", "name", "day" FROM read_csv('{dir}/Sales 2026.csv', header = true, delim = ';')
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(amount) AS with_amount FROM main.sales_2026
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "main"."tags" AS SELECT * FROM read_json('{dir}/tags.json', format = 'array')
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "main"."sales_file" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv('{dir}/Sales 2026.csv', header = true, delim = ';')
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM main.sales_file
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{dir}/*.csv', delim = ';', filename = true, union_by_name = true) LIMIT 100
COPY "main"."sales_2026" TO '{dir}/sales.parquet' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)
COPY (SELECT * FROM main.sales_2026 WHERE id = 1) TO '{dir}/one.tsv' (FORMAT csv, HEADER true, DELIMITER '	')
COPY "main"."sales_2026" TO '{dir}/sales.json' (FORMAT json, ARRAY true)
COPY "main"."sales_2026" TO '{dir}/sales.ndjson' (FORMAT json)
COPY "main"."sales_2026" TO '{dir}/by_day' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION snappy, PARTITION_BY ("day"), OVERWRITE_OR_IGNORE true)
SELECT count(*) AS "rows" FROM read_parquet('{dir}/sales.parquet')
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{dir}/one.tsv', header = true, delim = '	') LIMIT 100
SELECT count(*) AS "rows" FROM read_json('{dir}/sales.json', format = 'array')
SELECT count(*) AS "rows" FROM read_json('{dir}/sales.ndjson', format = 'newline_delimited')
SELECT count(*) AS "rows" FROM read_parquet('{dir}/by_day/*/*.parquet', union_by_name = true)
ATTACH '{dir}/lake.duckdb' AS "lake"
CREATE TABLE lake.main.trips AS SELECT range AS id, range % 3 AS zone FROM range(250)
CHECKPOINT "lake"
EXPORT DATABASE "lake" TO '{dir}/lake_export' (FORMAT parquet)
DETACH DATABASE IF EXISTS "lake"
ATTACH '{dir}/lake.duckdb' AS "lake_ro" (READ_ONLY)
INSERT INTO lake_ro.main.trips VALUES (999, 0)
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM lake_ro.main.trips
DETACH DATABASE IF EXISTS "lake_ro"
IMPORT DATABASE '{dir}/lake_export'
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM main.trips
SUMMARIZE "main"."sales_2026"
SUMMARIZE SELECT * FROM read_csv('{dir}/Sales 2026.csv', header = true, delim = ';') LIMIT 100
SELECT "name" AS value, count(*) AS n FROM "main"."sales_2026" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 10

SELECT CAST(least(floor((CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) - s.lo) / nullif(s.hi - s.lo, 0) * 20), 19) AS INTEGER) AS bucket, any_value(s.lo) AS lo, any_value(s.hi) AS hi, count(*) AS n FROM "main"."sales_2026", (SELECT min(CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE)) AS lo, max(CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE)) AS hi FROM "main"."sales_2026") AS s WHERE "amount" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(least(floor((epoch(CAST("day" AS TIMESTAMP)) - s.lo) / nullif(s.hi - s.lo, 0) * 20), 19) AS INTEGER) AS bucket, any_value(s.lo) AS lo, any_value(s.hi) AS hi, count(*) AS n FROM "main"."sales_2026", (SELECT min(epoch(CAST("day" AS TIMESTAMP))) AS lo, max(epoch(CAST("day" AS TIMESTAMP))) AS hi FROM "main"."sales_2026") AS s WHERE "day" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(least(floor((CAST("id" AS DOUBLE) - s.lo) / nullif(s.hi - s.lo, 0) * 20), 19) AS INTEGER) AS bucket, any_value(s.lo) AS lo, any_value(s.hi) AS hi, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT * FROM main.trips) AS q, (SELECT min(CAST("id" AS DOUBLE)) AS lo, max(CAST("id" AS DOUBLE)) AS hi FROM (SELECT * FROM main.trips) AS q) AS s WHERE "id" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SET autoinstall_known_extensions = false
SET autoload_known_extensions = false
SELECT * FROM read_xlsx('{dir}/book.xlsx', sheet = 'Data') LIMIT 100
ATTACH '{dir}/legacy.db' AS "legacy" (TYPE sqlite, READ_ONLY)
RESET autoinstall_known_extensions
RESET autoload_known_extensions
CHECKPOINT
FORCE CHECKPOINT
